hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Tubing head adapter
function: The crossover between the tubing head and the tree that seals on the tubing hanger neck and carries the tree.

tabs.overview: Flanged below to the tubing head and above to the lower master; seals on the hanger extended neck so the tubing pressure is isolated from the annulus.
tabs.engineering: API 6A; rating matched to the tree.
tabs.safety: Tested with the tree before the well is opened.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
